requirements.quote:
ACK frames MUST only be carried in a packet that has the same packet
   number space as the packet being acknowledged; see Section 12.1.  For
   instance, packets that are protected with 1-RTT keys MUST be
   acknowledged in packets that are also protected with 1-RTT keys.
requirements.condition: When an ACK frame acknowledges a packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Carry the ACK frame in a packet belonging to the same packet number space as the acknowledged packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not carry the ACK frame in a packet belonging to a different packet number space from the acknowledged packet.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation test can compare the packet number space of each ACK-carrying packet with that of every packet it acknowledges.

requirements.quote:
ACK frames MUST only be carried in a packet that has the same packet
   number space as the packet being acknowledged; see Section 12.1.  For
   instance, packets that are protected with 1-RTT keys MUST be
   acknowledged in packets that are also protected with 1-RTT keys.
requirements.condition: When acknowledging a packet protected with 1-RTT keys.
requirements.required_behavior: Send the acknowledgment in a packet that is also protected with 1-RTT keys.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not acknowledge a 1-RTT-protected packet in a packet protected with other keys.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet trace can verify the protection level of an acknowledged 1-RTT packet and the packet carrying its acknowledgment.

requirements.quote:
Packets that a client sends with 0-RTT packet protection MUST be
   acknowledged by the server in packets protected by 1-RTT keys.  This
requirements.condition: When the server acknowledges a packet that the client sent with 0-RTT packet protection.
requirements.required_behavior: The server must carry the acknowledgment in a packet protected by 1-RTT keys.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server must not carry the acknowledgment in a packet using a protection level other than 1-RTT.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet trace can identify client 0-RTT packets and verify that the server packets acknowledging them use 1-RTT protection.
